answer: A still of a public path cannot prove only one body walked it. Admission binds each key to one surveyed spiral walk: start at a numbered garden gate, stay inside the chalk coil, and seat a tagged stake on the assigned dune crest in an 11-minute slot, filmed as one take. Clerks post H=blake2s(addr||gate_id||coil_marks||stake_serial||slot). Fee is 0.33 POA; a 15 POA bond lasts ten epochs. Auditors overlay the take on the gate camera and match the stake assay to the crest map. A skipped coil, reused stake, or off-slot crest visit seizes the bond and blinds both keys for thirteen epochs.
